text: Hi, I'm the Fonada assistant. I can find your Salesforce contacts and leads, call them through Fonada, start outbound calling campaigns from a Salesforce Campaign or Account, send WhatsApp or RCS messages, search your knowledge base and check credits.

raw.message: Hi, I'm the Fonada assistant. I can find your Salesforce contacts and leads, call them through Fonada, start outbound calling campaigns from a Salesforce Campaign or Account, send WhatsApp or RCS messages, search your knowledge base and check credits.

text:
I can use these Fonada MCP tools:

Salesforce Integration:

find_crm_record - Find a Salesforce contact or lead by name
get_crm_call_list - Build a call list from a Salesforce Campaign or Account

Voice/Telephony:

voice_list_agents - List available telephony agents
voice_campaigns_test_single_call - Test call to one number
voice_campaigns_list_leads - List leads in a campaign
voice_campaigns_get_lead_summary - Get aggregate disposition summary
voice_campaigns_get_cdr_report - Fetch call detail records
voice_campaigns_pause - Pause a running campaign
voice_campaigns_resume - Resume a paused campaign
voice_campaigns_stop - Stop a campaign permanently
voice_upload_leads - Upload a leads CSV

WhatsApp:

whatsapp_list_templates - List approved message templates
whatsapp_send_template_message - Send a template message
whatsapp_send_text - Send a plain text message (within 24-hour window)

RCS:

rcs_send_test_message - Send a test RCS message

Knowledge Base:

knowledge_base_search - Search an agent's indexed documents
knowledge_base_add_text - Add text to an agent's knowledge base

Analytics:

analytics_list_kpis - List KPI definitions for an agent
orchestrator_campaign_report - Get full campaign report with KPIs

Credits:

credits_get_balance - Check credit balance

How can I help you today?
